title: Felt parser: source tokens → AST
description: Recursive descent parser using the chumsky crate with logos-chumsky zero-copy adapter. Produce typed AST nodes: FnDef, Let, If, Match, Lambda, Pipe, Apply, Literal (Int/Float/Bool/String), List, Set, Record, ListComp, BinOp, UnOp. Operator precedence: pipe (lowest) → or → and → comparison → additive → multiplicative → unary (highest). Where clauses desugar to nested lets. Pipe a |> f desugars to f(a). Use chumsky's error recovery for good diagnostics. Dependencies: chumsky, logos (via adapter).
